title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 74
paragraphs: After this, when it came to light that he had engineered the plot against Demaratus, Cleomenes grew frightened of the Spartans and withdrew to Thessaly. From there he went to Arcadia and began to stir up trouble, binding the Arcadians together against Sparta. Among other oaths by which he made them swear that they would follow him wherever he led, he was especially eager to bring the Arcadian leaders to the city of Nonacris and have them swear by the water of the Styx. For near this city, according to the Arcadians, is the water of the Styx, and there is in fact something of the kind: a thin trickle of water drips from a rock into a hollow gully, and a wall of rough stones runs around the gully. Nonacris, where this spring is located, is an Arcadian town near Pheneos.
